scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Charting the Deep staging from entering an avoidable environmental-monitoring gap during a venue systems outage.
Emerging Need: A tentative HVAC isolation becomes risky only after loan crates are slated to be onsite while fixed sensors will be unavailable.
Decision Context: The records separate general schedule noise from the museum’s backup-monitoring rule and identify whether a reversible prevention path exists before the venue security freeze.
Consequence: If the window closes without preparation, the crates may sit through the outage with no independent humidity record, complicating later condition accountability.

parameter.title: Charting the Deep condition staging call
parameter.description: Coordinate condition-photo sequence for Charting the Deep crates after Estuary Science Center receipt; no facility shutdowns listed.

parameter.subject: Early notice: possible east-wing HVAC isolation
parameter.body: Engineering may isolate east-wing HVAC overnight Monday August 17 if a damper part arrives. We will decide on August 10. Charting the Deep delivery staging is still being sequenced, so loan crates may or may not be in the east-wing corridor by then.

parameter.content: ESC's draft receiving map now puts the Charting the Deep crates in the east-wing gallery by Sunday August 16, sealed until Tuesday morning. Their last note says the house BMS trend screen is what they normally watch; I don't see spare portable loggers listed.

parameter.subject: August 15-18 east-wing access freeze and add-on cutoff
parameter.body: For August 15-18, east-wing delivery and equipment add-ons must be on the facility form by Wednesday August 12 at noon. Unlisted packages, devices, and vendor entries will be held until the access freeze lifts.

parameter.subject: Confirmed: east-wing HVAC isolation August 17
parameter.body: The damper part is confirmed. East-wing HVAC isolation is scheduled for Monday August 17, 18:00, through Tuesday August 18, 06:00. During the isolation the east gallery BMS humidity trend will be offline. Battery-powered portable devices are allowed if listed on the August 12 facility add-on form, and small deliveries can be received Friday August 14.

parameter.subject: East-wing add-on list frozen
parameter.body: The facility add-on list for August 15-18 froze at noon today. Items and vendor entries not already listed cannot be admitted to the east wing until Wednesday August 19.
